content: Isha Agarwal called Ravi Menon from Secure Future Group to check on the activation status of her home policy (#HC-2026-0456). Ravi informed her that the policy was pending due to a missing proof of residence document. Isha provided the document file name (Isha_Agarwal_ResidenceProof_Sept2026.pdf) during the call, which Ravi attached to the policy, noting it will be active within 24 hours. Isha also inquired about the deductible amount before the call concluded.

action_items: Review and activate policy within 24 hours
Provide the deductible amount to the customer
